bibles.licence: SimpleWorship includes the King James Version and the World English Bible, which are in the public domain. You can import OSIS, Zefania, OpenSong, USX and USFM files (or a zip of them). Most modern translations are copyrighted: only import Bibles you are licensed to show.
bibles.title: Bibles

connect.manual: Or open this address on the phone and type the code:
connect.qrAlt: QR code to connect a phone
connect.sameWifi: The code works once, for five minutes. Phones never connect through the internet.
connect.step1: Connect the phone to the same Wi-Fi as this computer.
connect.step2: Scan this code with the phone's camera and open the link.
connect.step3: Give the phone a name and tap Connect; SimpleWorship asks you what it may do.
connect.title: Connect a Phone
countdown.thenNext: then go to the next item

decks.needsLibreOffice: To import PowerPoint or Keynote, save as PDF (or install LibreOffice).

designer.everySlide: Show the reference on every slide (not just the first)

firstRun.title: Bring your library across?

format.selectWords: Select words to style just those, or style the whole box
format.sizeHint: The largest size; long text shrinks to fit
format.wholeBox: Styling the whole box · double-click to type
import.bibleHint: Check the short names: a Bible copied from another may still carry the other's name. Only import Bibles you are licensed to use.
import.intro: SimpleWorship can import songs from EasyWorship 6/7, OpenLP, ProPresenter 6, OpenLyrics, ChordPro and CCLI SongSelect files, and Bibles, pictures, videos and sound from EasyWorship. The other program's files are only read, never changed.
import.mediaDuplicates: {count} are already in the media library and are left out.
import.mediaMissing: {missing} of {total} files are not where EasyWorship keeps them (its Resources folder). If you copied them from the church computer, show where.
import.mediaTitle: Pictures, videos and sound from EasyWorship
import.noResources: No Resources folder was found near the EasyWorship library.
import.noneInFolder: None of the missing files are in that folder.
import.nothingFound: Nothing was found in the usual places. Choose a folder: for example a copy of EasyWorship's folders from a Windows computer, or a folder of song files.
import.nothingInFolder: Nothing SimpleWorship can import was found in that folder.
import.title: Import from Other Software
import.unsupported: {count} in a format SimpleWorship cannot play
import.unsupportedHint: Convert these to MP4 (videos) or PNG/JPEG (pictures), then import them in the Media tab:
insert.notInBible: That passage is not in this Bible.
insert.title: Insert Scripture
insert.withReference: Add the reference on its own line
inspector.appliedLook: Background and theme applied to every slide.
inspector.slideHint: Click a text box, shape or picture to change it. Double-click a text box to type.
inspector.videoHint: Videos on a slide loop. Transparent videos (and animated WebP or PNG) show the slide through.
label.shrink: Shrink to fit its box · or drag the “{name}” box on the preview
library.title: Library
media.deleteMany: Delete {count} items? Themes and schedule items that use them will show nothing in their place.
media.deleteOne: Delete “{name}”? Themes and schedule items that use it will show nothing in its place.
media.empty: Nothing here yet. Import images or videos to use as backgrounds, logos, or schedule items, and MP3 or M4A files for background music. MP4 (H.264) videos play everywhere.
ndi.hint: Receivers on the network list these after this computer's name. The words come with transparency; videos show as a still, alerts as a still banner.
ndi.noRuntime: NDI needs the free NDI Tools (or NDI Runtime) on this computer.
ndi.notSupported: NDI is not available on this system yet.
ndi.send: Send the stream look over NDI (vMix, OBS, TriCaster…)
ndi.sendMain: Also send what the projector shows, as a second source
pairRequest.question: “{name}” wants to connect. What may it do?
pairRequest.title: A phone wants to connect
pane.nothingInPreview: Choose a song or some text to preview.
pane.removeSlideHint: Remove this slide from the schedule item
picker.noImages: No images in the library yet. Import some in the Media tab.
picker.noVideos: No videos in the library yet. Import some in the Media tab.
pictures.empty: No pictures in the library yet. Import some to add them.
pictures.title: Add Pictures
remote.noSongsInSchedule: There are no songs in the schedule.
remote.notASong: A song isn't live. Send one from the Songs tab.
remote.pairIntro: On the SimpleWorship computer, click Remote › Connect a Phone. Type the 6-digit code it shows, and a name the operator will recognise.
remote.reconnecting: Reconnecting… The phone shows the screen again as soon as the Wi-Fi is back.
remote.referenceHint: Type a reference, then Go (Enter) to preview and Go again to show it.
remote.removedText: The operator removed this phone from SimpleWorship. To use it again, pair it again with a new code.
remote.waitingForOperator: Waiting for the operator to allow this phone…
remotePanel.noneConnected: No phones are connected right now.
remotePanel.offHint: Control SimpleWorship from phones and tablets on the church Wi-Fi: the preacher's slides, the worship leader's songs, nursery alerts, a stage display.
remotePanel.settingsHint: Change what a phone may do, or remove it, in Settings › Phone Remote.
role.alertsHint: For the nursery and ushers: show and clear alerts, nothing else.
role.fullHint: Everything: live controls, schedule, songs, Bible, alerts and stage.
role.presenterHint: For the preacher: next and previous slide, sections, and Black.
role.stageHint: A stage display on a tablet: the words, the next slide, the clock. View only.
role.worshipLeaderHint: Songs only: send songs from the schedule live and move through them.
schedule.empty: Drag songs here from the library, or use “Add to Schedule”. Save the schedule with File › Save.

schedule.missingSongs.one: 1 song is not in your library.
schedule.missingSongs.other: {count} songs are not in your library.

schedule.notesPlaceholder: Only you see these, e.g. “Pastor prays after verse 2”
schedule.title: Schedule
screens.stageHint: For the musicians and the preacher: the words, the next slide, the clock.
screens.streamHint: The stream look, for a capture card or a video switcher.
scripture.noResults: No verses contain all of these words.
scripture.numbersHint: The scripture theme decides this; switch it here for this passage
scripture.pick: Pick a book and chapter, or type a reference above.
scripture.preparing: Preparing the bundled Bibles… This takes a few seconds the first time. You can also import your own with “Bibles…”.
settings.alertsHint: One click in the Alert panel. Put ___ where a number or name goes, e.g. “Parent of child ___, please come to the nursery”.
settings.autoUpdates: Look for new versions automatically (they are only installed when you say so)
settings.ccliHint: Added to every song's copyright line as “CCLI License # …”. Leave empty to leave it off.
settings.languageHint: Lines not translated yet are shown in English. To help translate, see the guide in the SimpleWorship project.
settings.remoteHint: Paired phones are listed here. Removing one disconnects it at once.
settings.remoteNoDevices: No phones are paired yet. Use Remote › Connect a Phone in the toolbar.
settings.remoteOn: Let phones and tablets on this network connect
settings.title: Settings
song.author: Author
song.help: Start each section with a tag on its own line, such as [Verse 1], [Chorus] or [Bridge]. A blank line starts a new slide.
song.needsTitle: Please give the song a title.
song.title: Title
songs.empty: Your library is empty. Add a song with “New Song”.
songs.search: Search songs by title, author or lyrics
stream.browserSource: Show the stream look in OBS or vMix (browser source)
stream.browserSourceHint: In OBS, add a Browser source, paste the link, and set the size to 1920 × 1080. The background is see-through, so the camera shows behind the words.
stream.intro: The stream shows the same slides as the projector, in its own look: by default, songs and scripture as a lower third over the camera.
stream.newLinkHint: A new link stops the old one working, if it was shared by mistake.
stream.panicHint: Black, Logo and Clear Text take the words off the stream and keep the camera visible.
stream.windowInScreens: For a capture card or a video switcher, switch on the Stream window in Screens.
text.placeholder: Type the text to show. Leave a blank line between slides.
text.title: Title
textBox.label: Text box
themes.deleteMessage: Delete “{name}”? Anything that uses it will use the default theme instead.
thumbs.cannotDraw: Cannot draw thumbnails in this window.
thumbs.cannotPlay: This file cannot be played here. MP4 (H.264) videos work best.
toolbar.updateHint: SimpleWorship {version} is downloaded. It installs when you click, never by itself.
updates.installFailed: The update could not be installed: {error}
updates.installMessage: SimpleWorship will restart. Save your schedule first if it has changes.
updates.liveMessage: Clear the live screen first (after the service is fine). The update waits until then.

usage.empty: No songs were shown live in this period.
usage.title: Song Usage (CCLI Report)
